name: Coordinator turn homes
responsibility: Remembers, for each coordinator turn, the conversation shown when it started and the checkouts it gave work to, so the dock shows the turn in the right conversation
description: A turn that delivered, steered or queued work, or whose delivery may have reached the workhorse, shows in the conversation of each workhorse it reached. A delegation the workhorse refused as busy or with an invalid body gave it nothing, and moves the turn nowhere. A turn that gave work to none shows in the conversation shown while it ran. A turn with no record shows in whatever conversation is shown. The timeline keeps only the turns of the shown conversation before it spends its budget.
